Let \(h(x)=f(x)+\frac{x^2}{2}\). Then the equation gives
\[
h(x)+h(y)=h(x+y),
\]
so for positive integers \(n\),
\[
h(n)=n h(1)=n\left(m+\frac12\right).
\]
Thus
\[
f(n)=h(n)-\frac{n^2}{2}
=n\left(m+\frac12\right)-\frac{n^2}{2}
=mn-\frac{n(n-1)}2.
\]
We need
\[
mn-\frac{n(n-1)}2=2019
\]
\[
2mn-n(n-1)=4038
\]
\[
n(2m-n+1)=4038.
\]
So \(n\) must be a positive divisor of \(4038=2\cdot 3\cdot 673\), which has
\[
(1+1)(1+1)(1+1)=8
\]
positive divisors. For each such \(n\),
\[
m=\frac{\frac{4038}{n}+n-1}{2}.
\]
Since \(4038\) has exactly one factor of \(2\), one of \(n\) and \(\frac{4038}{n}\) is even and the other odd, so \(\frac{4038}{n}+n-1\) is even. Thus every divisor gives a positive integer \(m\).

Therefore there are \(\boxed{8}\) positive integer pairs.
